name: stat
title: Stat
description: Summary figures: Stat, StatLabel, StatValue (a number, a Quantity or a node), StatHint and StatDelta (a change with its direction in words), in a responsive StatGroup list.
docs: `<StatDelta value comparison invert direction tone format locale labels>` shows a change beside a value: an arrow (mirrored in right to left) and the size of the change in a soft tone chip, then `comparison` ("vs. last week", your words). `value` is a ratio by default (0.12 reads "12%"); `format` takes `Intl.NumberFormat` options or a function. Its sign gives the direction (zero is flat) and the direction the tone: up is success, down destructive, flat neutral; `invert` swaps them for a metric where down is good, like cost. The arrow and colour are hidden from screen readers, which hear `labels.up/down/flat(formatted)` ("up 12%") and then the comparison, so the meaning never rests on colour or the icon. Override the labels in the page's language.
